Politics · India

Stalin alleges electricity bill discrepancies; Cauvery row discussed

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin has alleged discrepancies in electricity readings and demanded an extension for bill payments until these issues are resolved. Separately, Stalin has criticized Karnataka Chief Minister Vijay's 'unilateral' diplomacy in the Cauvery water dispute, calling for an all-party meeting. He also claimed Vijay is 'isolated' in Tamil Nadu on the Cauvery issue. Meanwhile, Karnataka held an all-party meeting backing a united stand on Cauvery, with its Chief Minister stating farmers' interests are paramount.
